# Copilot Instructions for simproch-dev

## Project overview
- Monorepo managed with Turborepo.
- Blog app lives in `apps/blog` and uses SvelteKit + mdsvex (`.svx` posts).

## Skills
- Blog post boilerplate skill: `.github/skills/create-blog-post/SKILL.md`

When asked to create a blog post, load and follow the skill file exactly.
